whenToUse: "Listen on" / "Follow on" links for a podcast, a video channel, a newsletter or a blog.
Offering an RSS or Atom feed with a copy button and the address visible.
avoidWhen: Social profile links in the site footer — use the footer's social list.
Share buttons for one article — use the article layout's share actions.
a11y: The links form a named group (the title, or "Follow"); links that open a new tab say so to screen readers.
No logos are bundled; icons are aria-hidden, so the visible text is the name. The feed copy result is announced.
